title: Apple is racing to make Siri more agentic
snippet: Bloomberg's Mark Gurman says CEO John Ternus is pressuring AI czar Craig Federighi to accelerate the Siri roadmap and deliver a powerful AI agent that can compete with OpenAI's Dots or Meta's Muse. While Federighi has delivered a functional version of Siri AI on an incredibly short timeline, the company has no illusions that it's keeping pace with its rivals. title: AI accounting platform Kabilio raises €10m

title: Stablecoin growth has stalled. The payments boom hasn't
